brandbook.positioning: Floristería ficticia de demostración en Medellín para elegir flores y una entrega con claridad. Tres arreglos de ejemplo, precios visibles y pedidos realmente guardados como demostraciones, sin pagos ni cumplimiento real.
brandbook.voice: Cálida, directa y en español. Nombrar arreglos, cantidades, franjas y resultados sin exageraciones ni promesas. Usar una sola advertencia de negocio ficticio por página y explicar conflictos con acciones concretas, conservando siempre la elección del visitante.
brandbook.motif: La mesa de envoltura: un campo lavanda con pliegues SVG conectados y un borde inferior sólido donde se encuentran arreglo, etiqueta y decisión. Los tres ramos son ilustraciones vectoriales propias con especies y papeles diferenciados; el motivo continúa en selección, revisión, confirmación y panel sin fingir fotografía.

examples.title: Cover composition
examples.text: Use mixed-case typography, one complete petal and a quiet lower margin. Do not introduce bouquet photography.

pages.title: The Brand
pages.summary: Open this chapter on #7042A6 with white type. Introduce the wrapping table as the organizing idea, not as a claim about real premises.

examples.title: Flores para elegir con claridad
examples.text: Un arreglo reconocible. Un precio visible. Una entrega de demostración elegida paso a paso.

pages.title: Welcome
pages.summary: This guide presents an original identity proposed for this project, with examples of its visual and editorial use.

examples.title: Required site notice
examples.text: Negocio ficticio: arreglos, imágenes, precios y condiciones de ejemplo.

examples.title: Notice placement
examples.text: Show the notice exactly once on each website page, in a readable footer or closing block. Medellín, products and prices are supplied examples.

examples.title: Demonstration boundary
examples.text: Review and confirmation must explain real demonstration storage without payments, external messages or real deliveries.

pages.title: Index
pages.summary: Use a left-aligned editorial index with page numbers on a common edge. Group chapters by purpose rather than repeating decorative cards.

examples.title: Identity · 05–15
examples.text: Definition, purpose, voice and the Pétalo Norte logo system.

examples.title: Visual language · 16–29
examples.text: Typography, layout, palette, icons and original vector imagery.

examples.title: Applications · 30–49
examples.text: Design studies for the catalog, demonstration orders, private panel and physical materials.

pages.title: Defining
pages.summary: Define the identity through a complete arrangement, a continuous lavender plane and a connected working edge. Always distinguish the inspected specimen from the selected order.

examples.title: Inspecting
examples.text: Estás viendo Brisa · Alstroemerias blancas, follaje y papel lavanda.

examples.title: Choosing
examples.text: Tu selección · Brisa × 1. Puedes seguir explorando antes de revisar.

pages.title: Vision & Mission
pages.summary: Express the supplied project purpose, not an invented corporate ambition. Make identification, price and delivery choice clear before asking for personal information.

examples.title: Project purpose
examples.text: Elegir flores y una entrega con claridad.

examples.title: Practical expression
examples.text: Consulta el arreglo, revisa el precio y elige una fecha y una franja disponibles.

pages.title: Brand Values
pages.summary: Treat clarity, continuity and care as proposed design principles, not verified company values. Translate each principle into visible interface behavior.

examples.title: Clarity
examples.text: Brisa · $85.000 COP · Estado de disponibilidad junto al precio.

examples.title: Continuity
examples.text: El mismo arreglo vectorial acompaña la selección, la revisión y el pedido guardado.

examples.title: Care
examples.text: Conservamos tu selección. Revisa la disponibilidad actual antes de continuar.

pages.title: Tone of Voice
pages.summary: Write the customer journey in warm, direct Spanish. Name the action and its result; avoid superlatives, urgency tactics and claims of real fulfillment.

examples.title: Use
examples.text: Elige una fecha y una franja para tu pedido de demostración.

examples.title: Avoid
examples.text: Do not write “Entrega garantizada” or “Las mejores flores de Medellín”. Neither claim belongs to this project.

examples.title: Recovery
examples.text: Esta franja ya no está disponible. Elige otra sin perder los datos que ingresaste.

pages.title: Logo
pages.summary: Introduce the logo system on white. Pair the upward petal with the exact name Pétalo Norte; keep botanical illustrations separate from the signature.

examples.title: Chapter specimen
examples.text: Pétalo Norte

examples.title: Signature rule
examples.text: One petal, one name. Never place Brisa, Pulso or Claro inside the logo lockup.

pages.title: Logo overview
pages.summary: The original asymmetric petal suggests upward growth and folded paper. Its lavender fold is part of the geometry, not a highlight effect.

examples.title: Full signature
examples.text: Use the petal beside Pétalo Norte in the website header, with both elements vertically centered.

examples.title: Compact signature
examples.text: Use the petal alone for application icons. Keep the complete contour visible.

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.summary: Render Pétalo Norte separately in Bricolage Grotesque 700. Use mixed case, retain the accent and keep spacing compact without compressing letterforms.

examples.title: Header lockup
examples.text: A 32 px symbol with a 24 px name and a 12 px gap suits the compact header; the home-link target remains at least 44 px.

examples.title: Name integrity
examples.text: Always write Pétalo Norte. Never substitute Petalo Norte, PÉTALO NORTE or a name embedded in the symbol SVG.

pages.title: Logo Safezone
pages.summary: Define x as one quarter of the visible symbol height. Leave at least x around the complete lockup; increase this space beside dense controls or illustration.

examples.title: Header spacing
examples.text: A 32 px visible petal requires at least 8 px of clear space around the signature, separate from its touch-target padding.

examples.title: Printed study
examples.text: For a 24 mm petal, reserve 6 mm clear space. Keep paper folds, trim edges and dedication text outside it.

pages.title: Color combinations
pages.summary: Use violet and aubergine on lavender or white. On violet and aubergine applications, retain a lavender support surface behind the original symbol and use white name text.

examples.title: Light header
examples.text: Lavender table #EEE8F5, violet petal #7042A6 and aubergine Pétalo Norte #302139.

examples.title: Dark cover
examples.text: Aubergine #302139 with a white name; the unchanged petal sits on a clear lavender support area.

examples.title: Single-ink study
examples.text: Use the same outer contour in violet, with the fold knocked out to the supporting paper. Do not redraw the petal.

pages.title: Brandmark
pages.summary: Keep the petal upright and preserve its asymmetric curves and connected fold. Use one shared source drawing for the header, favicon and application icons.

examples.title: Small symbol
examples.text: At 16–32 px, use the single-color interpretation on lavender, preserving the recognizable tip and outer contour.

examples.title: Large symbol
examples.text: On a chapter opener, enlarge the complete petal with generous margins. Never crop its tip or base.

pages.title: Logo misuse
pages.summary: Do not rotate, stretch, outline or soften the symbol. Do not attach sales badges, floral illustrations or decorative shadows to the name.

examples.title: Incorrect orientation
examples.text: A sideways petal loses the upward direction of Pétalo Norte. Restore the original upright drawing.

examples.title: Incorrect treatment
examples.text: No gradients, glow, photographic texture or bouquet-filled letters. Use explicit palette fills and real typography.

examples.title: Incorrect placement
examples.text: Do not place the violet mark directly on violet. Restore its lavender support surface.

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Introduce typography with one mixed-case headline and a short supporting line. Bricolage Grotesque provides character; Source Sans 3 carries practical information.

examples.title: Flores para elegir con claridad
examples.text: Explora Brisa, Pulso y Claro. Elige el arreglo que quieres incluir.

examples.title: Divider setting
examples.text: Use a 56 px Bricolage Grotesque 700 heading and an 18 px Source Sans 3 400 introduction; keep both left aligned.

pages.title: Typography overview
pages.summary: Use only the two supplied families. Distributable files are provided for both; a temporary system fallback is not a third identity typeface.

examples.title: Tu selección, a la vista
examples.text: Revisa los nombres, las cantidades y la entrega antes de guardar.

examples.title: Family roles
examples.text: Bricolage Grotesque handles the name and headings. Source Sans 3 handles prices, labels, inputs, status text and buttons.

pages.title: Primary typeface
pages.summary: Set the name and main headings in Bricolage Grotesque 600–700. Let its character work through scale and spacing, not uppercase or condensed transformations.

examples.title: Una mesa, tres arreglos
examples.text: Brisa, Pulso y Claro tienen flores y envolturas distintas.

examples.title: Display specimen
examples.text: Use 56 px on wide screens and 36 px on compact screens. Wrap at natural phrase boundaries without isolating “Norte”.

pages.title: Typography
pages.summary: Use 700 for the name and primary headings, 600 for secondary headings and emphasis, and 400 for body copy. Keep practical UI text upright; never synthesize bold or italics.

examples.title: Revisa antes de guardar
examples.text: La revisión no reserva existencias ni cupos de entrega.

examples.title: Weight contrast
examples.text: Set “Brisa” in Bricolage Grotesque 700, “Cantidad” in Source Sans 3 600 and explanatory copy in Source Sans 3 400.

examples.title: Style restraint
examples.text: Use Source Sans 3 600 for “Guardar pedido de demostración”. Do not use italics or all caps to signal urgency.

pages.title: Supporting type
pages.summary: Use Source Sans 3 at 18 or 16 px for reading and at least 16 px in inputs. Secondary labels stay at least 12 px; button text stays at least 14 px.

examples.title: Elige tu franja
examples.text: 09:00–12:00 o 14:00–18:00, según disponibilidad para la fecha elegida.

examples.title: Numeric setting
examples.text: Keep “$115.000 COP” together. Align quantities and prices consistently in order specifications and owner rows.

pages.title: Hierarchy
pages.summary: Lead with the page task, then arrangement name, price and action. Keep availability close to the action and explanatory copy below; never compete with the flower scene.

examples.title: Brisa
examples.text: Alstroemerias blancas, follaje y papel lavanda · $85.000 COP

examples.title: Scale sequence
examples.text: Use 56/36 px for page headings, 18 px for key descriptions, 16 px for controls and 12 px minimum for secondary references.

examples.title: Action order
examples.text: “Pedir este arreglo” is primary on Inicio. “Ver catálogo” is secondary, with visibly less emphasis.

pages.title: Layouts
pages.summary: Build around one continuous lavender scene and a solid lower edge joined to both sides. Use the 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/72 px spacing scale; never overlay labels on flowers.

examples.title: Tu arreglo, completo
examples.text: Consulta el nombre y el precio en el borde de la mesa.

examples.title: Wide and medium
examples.text: Center the scene at 1440 px. At 768 px, place it above the form; only short fields may share two columns.

examples.title: 390 × 640 study
examples.text: Budget 48 px navigation, 36 title, 112 scene, 144 specification/action and 136 date/slots. Errors extend the flow; taller screens enlarge the scene.

pages.title: Colors
pages.summary: Introduce the palette with lavender as the field and violet as the decision color. Use aubergine for reading and white for paper-like surfaces.

examples.title: Core pairing
examples.text: Pétalo Norte uses #EEE8F5 behind the arrangement and #7042A6 for “Pedir este arreglo”.

examples.title: Supporting pairing
examples.text: Use #FFFFFF for a review surface and #302139 for its specification. Reserve #315B45 for supporting botanical and status details.

pages.title: Colors overview
pages.summary: Preserve all five supplied palette values. Aviso #875000 is an additional semantic warning token, not a replacement for Stem Green or a sixth brand surface.

examples.title: Surfaces
examples.text: Lavender Table #EEE8F5 · Paper White #FFFFFF.

examples.title: Brand and text
examples.text: Clear Violet #7042A6 · Aubergine Ink #302139 · Stem Green #315B45. Muted text remains fully readable.

examples.title: Warning
examples.text: Aviso #875000 accompanies “Esta franja está completa” with text and an icon, never color alone.

pages.title: Using Tints
pages.summary: Use the supplied solid colors as the default, rather than inventing pale palette variants. Never reduce text opacity to create hierarchy or soften SVG contours with filters.

examples.title: Quiet surface
examples.text: Place secondary information on #EEE8F5 with full-strength #315B45 text instead of faded green.

examples.title: Unavailable control
examples.text: Keep “Agotado” readable. Use a distinct boundary and disabled behavior instead of a barely visible violet button.

examples.title: Contrast rule
examples.text: Keep control boundaries and focus indicators at least 3:1 against adjacent colors; use aubergine or violet on light surfaces.

pages.title: Graphic Elements
pages.summary: Use connected paper folds, complete stems and a stable working edge. Each arrangement has one canonical vector composition; illustration colors do not become new interface tokens.

examples.title: Brisa
examples.text: White alstroemerias, foliage and lavender paper. Keep the entire bouquet visible on the lavender table.

examples.title: Pulso
examples.text: Fuchsia gerberas, pink carnations and white paper. Preserve the same recognizable composition across selection and review.

examples.title: Claro
examples.text: Sunflowers, foliage and violet paper. Flower colors belong to the artwork; drawn flower counts never define units sold.

pages.title: Icons
pages.summary: Use simple, consistent interface icons with explicit labels. Keep the petal exclusive to identity; status icons must not resemble new logo variants.

examples.title: Date control
examples.text: Pair a calendar icon with “Fecha de entrega”. The full control target is at least 44 × 44 px.

examples.title: Owner status
examples.text: Pair a check icon with “Entregado”; do not communicate the state through green alone.

examples.title: Selection controls
examples.text: Use named actions such as “Retirar Brisa”. A small × without an accessible label is insufficient.

pages.title: Vector imagery
pages.summary: Replace the photography chapter with original vector art. No product photographs or raster imagery are planned; keep full contours, crisp fills and consistent species references.

examples.title: Main specimen
examples.text: Brisa appears complete and centered, with its paper base above the connected label edge. Do not crop petals for drama.

examples.title: Material detail
examples.text: An independent vector study shows paper folds and stems. Label it “Detalle de envoltura”; never use it instead of the selected bouquet.

examples.title: Saved appearance
examples.text: Order views retain the arrangement version saved with each line, rather than silently adopting a redesigned bouquet.

pages.title: Moodboard
pages.summary: Use a vector-only direction board. Compare the supplied herbarium, shop-window and wrapping-table concepts; select the wrapping table for continuity from discovery to saving.

examples.title: Selected: wrapping table
examples.text: Lavender plane, complete Brisa, connected paper folds and a lower working edge holding the decision.

examples.title: Alternatives
examples.text: Herbarium contributes editorial indexing; shop-window contributes frontal clarity. Neither replaces the selected continuous table.

examples.title: Exclude
examples.text: No split hero, repeated product cards, cream-and-serif catalog, uppercase headlines or decorative animation.

pages.title: Applications
pages.summary: All following applications are design studies. Carry the same name, petal, lavender plane and working edge across formats without implying launched channels or real fulfillment.

examples.title: Pétalo Norte
examples.text: Tres arreglos para explorar. Una selección para revisar con claridad.

examples.title: Shared composition
examples.text: Keep the specimen above the information edge. Scale the scene to the format instead of turning every application into a product card.

pages.title: Social media icons
pages.summary: Design study: use the shared petal as the avatar, centered on lavender. Keep the contour inside the circular crop and omit the name at small sizes.

examples.title: Pétalo Norte
examples.text: Arreglos florales de demostración.

examples.title: Avatar crop
examples.text: Keep the petal within the central 60% of the square. Use #EEE8F5 as support and preserve the upward tip.

pages.title: Social media profiles
pages.summary: Design study: pair the petal avatar with the exact display name and a factual Spanish bio. Do not invent handles, contact details, opening hours or a real storefront.

examples.title: Pétalo Norte
examples.text: Floristería ficticia en Medellín. Explora Brisa, Pulso y Claro en un catálogo de demostración.

examples.title: Profile composition
examples.text: Use a complete Brisa illustration in the banner, with its name on the lower edge. Keep the profile text outside the artwork.

pages.title: Instagram posts
pages.summary: Design study: show one complete arrangement per post. Place its name and example price in a solid lower band; keep botanical descriptions brief and avoid promotional claims.

examples.title: Conoce Pulso
examples.text: Gerberas fucsias, claveles rosados y papel blanco. Precio de ejemplo: $115.000 COP.

examples.title: Post composition
examples.text: Use a lavender field, generous side margins and a connected lower label band. No floating price sticker or petal crop.

examples.title: Caption detail
examples.text: La ilustración identifica el arreglo; la cantidad de flores dibujadas no indica unidades vendidas.

pages.title: Posters
pages.summary: Design study: use one headline, one complete bouquet and one information edge. Do not add a fabricated event, address, QR destination or delivery promise.

examples.title: Una mesa, tres posibilidades
examples.text: Brisa · Pulso · Claro. Arreglos de ejemplo de Pétalo Norte.

examples.title: Poster hierarchy
examples.text: Place the headline above Brisa. Align the arrangement names and Pétalo Norte signature along the same lower edge.

pages.title: T shirts and totes
pages.summary: Design study: use a single violet petal and restrained name placement. Preserve clear space across seams and folds; these are visual studies, not merchandise listings.

examples.title: Pétalo Norte
examples.text: Flores para elegir con claridad.

examples.title: Tote layout
examples.text: Center the petal above the name on white fabric. Keep the fold knocked out and leave at least one symbol-width below the handles.

examples.title: T-shirt layout
examples.text: Use a small left-chest signature rather than a repeated logo pattern. Do not stretch the mark to match the garment width.

pages.title: Bouquet wrapping
pages.summary: Design study: translate the connected fold motif into wrapping and labels. Retain each arrangement’s assigned paper color; do not claim material certifications or protective performance.

examples.title: Brisa
examples.text: Alstroemerias blancas, follaje y papel lavanda.

examples.title: Paper assignment
examples.text: Brisa uses lavender paper, Pulso white paper and Claro violet paper. Keep each name legible on a separate supporting label.

examples.title: Fold placement
examples.text: Align the label with a real fold edge in the study. Avoid loose diagonal rules that appear unrelated to the wrapping.

pages.title: Delivery context
pages.summary: Design study: replace pickup-location messaging with the planned delivery context. Show Medellín only as the supplied example; do not suggest a shop address or pickup service.

examples.title: Elige tu entrega
examples.text: Medellín, como ubicación de ejemplo. Domicilio ilustrativo: $12.000 COP por pedido.

examples.title: Date and slot panel
examples.text: Offer today through day 30 in America/Bogota. Show 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, with full or past slots identified and unavailable.

examples.title: Capacity explanation
examples.text: Each date/slot allows six demonstration orders. One order uses one slot place, even when it contains several arrangements.

pages.title: Order controls
pages.summary: Design study: give every control a visible label and a 44 px target. Use violet for the next valid action; preserve invalid input and explain recovery without changing the selection.

examples.title: Agregar Brisa
examples.text: Elige una cantidad entera mayor que cero. Puedes agregar otros arreglos antes de continuar.

examples.title: Catalog interaction
examples.text: A valid selection moves the label to the shared edge and updates scene, reference, name, price and action together. Reduced motion updates immediately.

examples.title: Owner controls
examples.text: Use “Marcar en preparación”, then “Marcar en camino”, then “Marcar entregado”. Catalog rows use “Pausar”, “Reactivar” and explicit stock saving.

pages.title: Order receipt
pages.summary: Design study: confirmation reads the session-authorized saved order at /pedido/confirmacion/[id]. Use its frozen lines and vector versions; show one specification, not repeated summaries.

examples.title: Pedido de demostración guardado
examples.text: El guardado es real como demostración, pero no genera cobros, mensajes externos ni entregas.

examples.title: Example specification
examples.text: Brisa × 1: $85.000 COP · Subtotal: $85.000 COP · Domicilio: $12.000 COP · Total: $97.000 COP · Estado: recibido.

examples.title: Private continuation
examples.text: Place delivery and personal details below the edge. “Consultar estado” requests the server record; the base confirmation route offers recovery.

pages.title: Return-visit card
pages.summary: Design study: adapt the rewards-card format into a simple arrangement reference card. Do not invent points, membership, discounts, stamps or redeemable benefits.

examples.title: ¿Cuál quieres explorar?
examples.text: Brisa · Pulso · Claro. Encuentra cada arreglo por su nombre en el catálogo.

examples.title: Card structure
examples.text: Use an editorial list on lavender with one small petal. The reverse may describe the three papers, without a loyalty grid.

pages.title: Florist sign
pages.summary: Design study: use the primary signature on an abstract sign panel, not a pictured real storefront. Maintain generous clear space and a lavender support for the symbol.

examples.title: Pétalo Norte
examples.text: Flores para elegir con claridad.

examples.title: Sign composition
examples.text: Set the name in white on aubergine, beside the lavender-supported petal. No invented street number, opening hours or service guarantee.

pages.title: Ordering website
pages.summary: Design study: organize the seven planned screens around discovery, review, private confirmation and owner work. Keep Spanish navigation direct, and never present a study as a working service.

examples.title: Pedir este arreglo
examples.text: Empieza con Brisa o explora el catálogo. Tu selección te acompaña al configurar el pedido.

examples.title: Public journey
examples.text: / opens Brisa; /catalogo supports #brisa, #pulso and #claro. Unknown references require an explicit choice. /pedido keeps configuration and review together.

examples.title: Private workspace
examples.text: /duena/acceso leads to /duena/pedidos for today’s agenda and /duena/catalogo for pauses and stock. Keep private access separate from customer actions.

pages.title: Favicon
pages.summary: Design study: derive the favicon, app/icon.svg and Apple icon from the same petal geometry. Keep a lavender support and replace starter symbols throughout the icon family.

examples.title: Pétalo Norte — Catálogo de arreglos
examples.text: Explora Brisa, Pulso y Claro.

examples.title: Icon family
examples.text: Use the same upright petal for browser and application icons. Any compatibility raster is derived from that symbol, not a separate illustration.

pages.title: Stationery
pages.summary: Design study: use an aubergine signature, a narrow lavender working edge and generous white space. Do not invent legal details or expose customer data in public examples.

examples.title: Selección de arreglos
examples.text: Brisa × 1 · Pulso × 1. Documento de ejemplo de Pétalo Norte.

examples.title: Page structure
examples.text: Align the name, document heading and line descriptions to one left edge. Keep private order details out of public stationery studies.

pages.title: Business cards
pages.summary: Design study: make a brand introduction card without fabricated contacts. Use the front for recognition and the reverse for the three arrangement names.

examples.title: Pétalo Norte
examples.text: Brisa, Pulso y Claro. Tres arreglos de ejemplo para explorar.

examples.title: Two-sided layout
examples.text: Front: violet petal and aubergine name on lavender. Reverse: white surface, editorial names and short botanical descriptions.

pages.title: Gift message card
pages.summary: Design study: interpret the gift-card format as a dedication insert, not stored value or a voucher. Keep the message dominant and the signature secondary.

examples.title: Para acompañar tu día
examples.text: Un pequeño gesto, elegido para ti.

examples.title: Message treatment
examples.text: Use Source Sans 3 on white with a small lavender edge. The planned dedication field is optional and allows up to 300 characters.

examples.title: No redemption
examples.text: Do not add a balance, redemption code, expiry date or “Canjear” action. No gift-value functionality is planned.

pages.title: Packaging seal
pages.summary: Design study: place the petal on a lavender seal across a paper fold. Treat it as identification, not evidence of freshness, tamper protection or real packing operations.

examples.title: Pétalo Norte
examples.text: Brisa · Papel lavanda.

examples.title: Seal placement
examples.text: Keep the symbol upright and fully inside the seal. Put the arrangement name on an adjacent label, not inside the petal.

pages.title: Customer support
pages.summary: Design study: provide recovery beside the affected action, not an invented chat or contact channel. Keep form values visible; never simulate saving when storage or session access is unavailable.

examples.title: Tu selección sigue aquí
examples.text: Las condiciones cambiaron. Compara los valores anteriores y actuales antes de revisar de nuevo.

examples.title: No pudimos confirmar el guardado
examples.text: Recupera el resultado del mismo envío antes de editar o iniciar otro pedido. No lo enviaremos como un pedido nuevo automáticamente.

examples.title: La sesión está bloqueada
examples.text: El navegador no permite guardar la sesión. Reintenta o abre el sitio directamente. Los datos del formulario siguen visibles.

pages.title: Thank you
pages.summary: This guide presents an original identity proposed for this project, with examples of its visual and editorial use.

examples.title: Gracias por elegir con claridad
examples.text: Pétalo Norte · Una mesa compartida entre arreglo, etiqueta y decisión.

examples.title: Sources
examples.text: User-supplied fictional brief, catalog, routes, palette and identity direction. Public research was not requested; no external identity sources are cited.

examples.title: Type and artwork
examples.text: Supplied files: Bricolage Grotesque and Source Sans 3. Original proposed petal in this guide; bouquet compositions follow the supplied vector direction.
